limitations: MAD and median both in raw play units, not log(play); a creator with one viral outlier can still show low MAD if the rest of their output is steady. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: One point per creator, creator_stats latest snapshot. Colour = reliability label (CONSISTENT/HIGH_VARIANCE/SMALL_SAMPLE).
title: Creator median vs MAD (dispersion)
